prompt: Create a facial expression sheet for this original paper-kite fantasy animal game character. Keep the reference head design, ivory and terracotta markings, turquoise eye, dark blue neck, clean 2D outlines, and the same left-facing three-quarter view. A regular two-by-two grid contains four complete isolated heads: top left neutral; top right determined with a lowered brow and narrowed eye; bottom left wincing with a closed eye and tense brow; bottom right content and smiling with a relaxed curved closed eye. Keep the head and neck silhouette, proportions and resting orientation consistent across all four heads. Only the eye, brow and small mouth expression change. Leave equal generous margins. Use a transparent background. No letters, captions, frame borders, scenery, bodies, or effects.
